description.value:
Your hand (or equivalent appendage) is a magitech prosthetic that can detach from your body and operate semi-autonomously. You can detach your hand as a single Interact action, and it becomes a Tiny construct with the magical and magitech traits on the ground in your space. It also has the minion trait, meaning it gains 2 actions during your turn if you Command it. Your hand can't make Strikes or wield weapons while detached. While it's detached, you can't use your hand other than by Commanding it. You can reattach your hand as a single Interact action as long as it shares your space. If your hand is destroyed, you can use it normally after reattaching it, though it can't be detached or Commanded until repaired.

Your hand's level, save modifiers, and AC are equal to yours. It uses 3 + your level as its modifier for Acrobatics, Perception, and Stealth checks, and for other skill checks, its modifier is equal to your level or your modifier in that skill, whichever is lower. It doesn't have or use its own attribute modifiers and can never benefit from item bonuses. Your hand has Hit Points equal to 5 times your level.

Your hand has low-light vision, and you can see through its sensors as long as it remains within 100 feet of you. It has a Speed of 25 feet and a climb Speed of 25 feet. It can perform manipulate actions as if it had a single hand, using its whole body, but it can't move while holding an item unless the item is of negligible Bulk.
